6h/24h are after i.p. LPS injection to sacrifice, not injection duration
GSE256105 each sample pools 2 mice, one female and one male
Genotype/treatment/6h fully in GSE254687; GSE256105 only LPS 24h
Genotype, LPS, time, assay and sex are not fully crossed across series
Two series GSE254687 and GSE256105 combined; GSE256105 lacks raw data
GSE254687 uses NovaSeq 6000; GSE256105 uses NextSeq 500
